precondition.description: A consuming micro-enterprise has accepted this provider's ActivityStreams ExecutableServiceOffer for a typed context packet naming: model (a Claude model id, optional — defaults to claude-opus-4-8), messages (a non-empty array of {role, content} chat turns), optionally max-tokens (accepted and echoed but not enforceable on the wire), and optionally params.outputSchema carrying one bounded JSON Schema no larger than 32768 bytes. The accepted ServiceContract carries a capability attenuated to the exact offer and packet digest; live execution additionally grants external-network and leader-inference-account.

move.description: The unit flattens the packet's messages into one prompt — a system message maps to --append-system-prompt; user/assistant turns are flattened, in order, and streamed to the print-mode subprocess over standard input — and spawns exactly one bounded `claude -p` subprocess (--model, --output-format json, --tools "" for an empty filesystem/tool allowlist, --strict-mcp-config with no --mcp-config for zero MCP servers, --setting-sources "" so no project or user settings are loaded, and --json-schema only when the accepted packet carries params.outputSchema) within a bounded fuel budget. Schema-bound output is provider-validated and separately preserved as structuredOutput while a report field remains prose. The move settles to exactly one of completion or refusal.

postcondition.description: An exchange record exists in the unit's own content/exchanges/ pool whose .outcome is exactly 'completion' (carrying the served model, response prose, finish reason, and provider-validated structured output in the raw provider result when contracted) or 'refusal' (a structured refusal record stating grounds) — settled within the bounded fuel budget, never a hang and never an untyped failure.

energetics.behavior: Every exchange terminates — as completion or as refusal — inside a bounded wall-clock fuel budget; the subprocess is killed on timeout; it never hangs, and it never returns an untyped failure.
energetics.measure: claude -p subprocess invocations made and wall-clock seconds consumed per exchange, recorded on the exchange record

refinements.implementation: src/contract-claude-code.js authors and validates Internal Market offers and accepted capabilities; run-one-exchange.mjs owns the one bounded local `claude -p` call (Node child_process.spawnSync, --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "", no vendored SDK)
